dishes.name: Paris-Brest
dishes.desc: A ring of choux pastry filled with praline cream, created in 1910 at Maisons-Laffitte, in the Yvelines near Versailles.

dishes.name: Petits pois à la française
dishes.desc: Young peas braised with butter, lettuce and onions, a dish that became a fashion at Louis XIV's court in Versailles.

dishes.name: Rambolitain
dishes.desc: Soft almond-macaron cake filled with light praline cream, topped with toasted almonds and hazelnuts. Created in Rambouillet in 1946 and now a recognised local speciality of the town.

dishes.name: Houdan poultry
dishes.desc: Roast chicken or capon of the five-toed Houdan breed, an IGP-protected poultry from Houdan in the western Yvelines. Traditionally roasted for festive meals.

dishes.name: Potage Saint-Germain
dishes.desc: Smooth green soup of split or fresh peas, named after Saint-Germain-en-Laye in the Yvelines. A French classic that the Yvelines department counts among its own specialities.
